name: lightsout
description: 熄灯盘 Lights Out — 浏览器原生点灯谜题. 每关最少按键数由 GF(2) 陪集枚举算出, 并在 4×4 上被按键图 BFS 全量复核.

scripts.check: for f in js/*.js js/*/*.js server.cjs electron/main.cjs tools/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo OK
scripts.unit: for f in test/*.test.mjs; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run unit

author: z-biz-game
